newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NatMut Asia prospects seen strong.
newsitem.headline: NatMut Asia prospects seen strong.

text.p: National Mutual Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday that the prospects for its 56 percent owned Hong Kong listed subsidiary, National Mutual Asia Ltd, remained strong.

"The prospects for 1997 remain strong with continued growth expected in our core individual life and health businesses," Naitonal Mutual Holdings chairman Athol Lapthorne told the company's annual meeting.
"We believe the change in sovereignty in mid-1997 will not have a significant impact on this growth," he said.
National Mutual Holdings has targeted Asia as its key market for expansion and has an application pending for a licence to operate in mainland China.
The group's share of National Mutual Asia's profit jumped 36.2 percent in 1995/96 (October-September) to A$99 million.

"The coming year will see us continuing to pursue opportunities in other parts of Asia. We are looking at opportunities in the emerging markets of India, Vietnam and the Philippines and have a licence application pending in Thailand," Lapthorne said.
